run_dataspeech_pitch_estimation: run dataspeech to compute pitch features on an audio dataset with configurable batch size and GPU workers
run_dataspeech_snr_reverb_estimation: run dataspeech to compute SNR and reverberation (C50) metrics on an audio dataset
run_dataspeech_speaking_rate: run dataspeech to compute speaking rate and phoneme count from audio and text columns
run_dataspeech_quality_estimation: run dataspeech with squim to compute SI-SDR, STOI, and PESQ audio quality scores
run_dataspeech_enrich_dataset: run dataspeech to enrich a HuggingFace audio dataset with pitch, SNR, reverb, rate, and quality features
